examples.english: The wedding was held at a luxurious venue, attended by many celebrities.

notes:
{豪華|ごうか} is a na-adjective describing something impressively luxurious, lavish, or gorgeous. It emphasizes visual splendor and high quality rather than mere expense.

FORMS:
- Modifier: {豪華|ごうか}な (e.g., {豪華|ごうか}な⟦ホテル→ホテル：01027_hoteru⟧)
- Adverbial: {豪華|ごうか}に (e.g., {豪華|ごうか}に⟦{飾|かざ}る→飾る：01185_kazaru⟧)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {豪華|ごうか}な⟦ホテル→ホテル：01027_hoteru⟧: luxury hotel
- {豪華|ごうか}な⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧: lavish cuisine
- {豪華|ごうか}⟦{客船|きゃくせん}→客船：16792_kyakusen⟧: luxury cruise liner
- {豪華|ごうか}⟦{絢爛|けんらん}→絢爛：09200_kenran⟧: gorgeous and dazzling (four-character idiom)
- {豪華|ごうか}⟦キャスト→キャスト：10872_kyasuto⟧: star-studded cast

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{贅沢|ぜいたく}→贅沢：03309_zeitaku⟧: extravagant, wastefully lavish (can be negative)
- ⟦{華麗|かれい}→華麗：09199_karei⟧: splendid, magnificent (more literary)
- {豪華|ごうか} is always positive, emphasizing grandeur and impressiveness
